# Type Alias: TransactWriteOptions

```ts
type TransactWriteOptions = Omit<TransactWriteCommandInput, "TransactItems">;
```

Transaction-level options for [DynamoDbRepository#transactWrite](../classes/DynamoDbRepository.md#transactwrite),
forwarded to the underlying `TransactWriteCommand`. Use it for options that
apply to the transaction as a whole, such as `ClientRequestToken` (for
idempotent retries) or `ReturnConsumedCapacity`.

# Variable: BodyMatcher

```ts
BodyMatcher: ZodDiscriminatedUnion<[ZodObject<{
  contentType: ZodLiteral<"text">;
  matcher: ZodDiscriminatedUnion<[ZodObject<{
     type: ZodLiteral<"equals">;
     value: ZodString;
   }, $strip>, ZodObject<{
     type: ZodLiteral<"contains">;
     value: ZodString;
   }, $strip>, ZodObject<{
     flags: ZodOptional<ZodString>;
     type: ZodLiteral<"regex">;
     value: ZodString;
   }, $strip>, ZodObject<{
     type: ZodLiteral<"exists">;
   }, $strip>, ZodObject<{
     type: ZodLiteral<"absent">;
  }, $strip>], "type">;
}, $strip>, ZodObject<{
  contentType: ZodLiteral<"json">;
  matcher: ZodDiscriminatedUnion<[ZodObject<{
     type: ZodLiteral<"equals">;
     value: ZodUnknown;
   }, $strip>, ZodObject<{
     type: ZodLiteral<"subset">;
     value: ZodUnknown;
  }, $strip>], "type">;
}, $strip>], "contentType">;
```

url: >-
  https://backpack.ns.nl/packages/@backpack/aws-lambda/rest/variables/CachePresets.md
---
[API reference](../../../../index.md) / [@backpack/aws-lambda](../../index.md) / [rest](../index.md) / CachePresets

# Variable: CachePresets

```ts
const CachePresets: object;
```

All cache presets collected in a single object for enum-like ergonomics.

## Type Declaration

### FIVE\_MINUTES

```ts
readonly FIVE_MINUTES: object;
```

Five-minute cache with `Vary: Accept-Language`.

A balanced preset for semi-dynamic data that changes a few times per hour.

#### Example

```ts
return jsonOk(data, { cache: CachePresets.FIVE_MINUTES });
// Cache-Control: max-age=300
// Vary: Accept-Language
```

#### FIVE\_MINUTES.maxAge

```ts
readonly maxAge: 300 = 300;
```

#### FIVE\_MINUTES.vary

```ts
readonly vary: readonly ["Accept-Language"];
```

### NO\_CACHE

```ts
readonly NO_CACHE: object;
```

Emits `Cache-Control: no-cache` and `Vary: Accept-Language`, forcing clients
and proxies to revalidate with the server before serving a cached copy.

The response may still be stored — use this when the data changes frequently
enough that stale serving is unacceptable, but caching still reduces
bandwidth on a successful revalidation (304 Not Modified).

For responses that must never be stored at all (e.g. sensitive data), use
`cache: false` directly instead.

#### Example

```ts
return jsonOk(liveStatus, { cache: CachePresets.NO_CACHE });
// Cache-Control: no-cache
// Vary: Accept-Language
```

#### NO\_CACHE.cacheControl

```ts
readonly cacheControl: CacheControlBuilder;
```

#### NO\_CACHE.vary

```ts
readonly vary: readonly ["Accept-Language"];
```

### ONE\_DAY

```ts
readonly ONE_DAY: object;
```

One-day cache with `Vary: Accept-Language`.

Suitable for daily-refreshed data such as saved trips or product catalogues.

#### Example

```ts
// Saved trips — refreshed once a day
return jsonOk(savedTrips, { cache: CachePresets.ONE_DAY });
// Cache-Control: max-age=86400
// Vary: Accept-Language
```

#### ONE\_DAY.maxAge

```ts
readonly maxAge: 86400 = 86_400;
```

#### ONE\_DAY.vary

```ts
readonly vary: readonly ["Accept-Language"];
```

### ONE\_HOUR

```ts
readonly ONE_HOUR: object;
```

One-hour cache with `Vary: Accept-Language`.

Suitable for data that changes infrequently within a day.

#### Example

```ts
// MijnNS personalised content — refreshed hourly
return jsonOk(mijnNsData, { cache: CachePresets.ONE_HOUR });
// Cache-Control: max-age=3600
// Vary: Accept-Language
```

#### ONE\_HOUR.maxAge

```ts
readonly maxAge: 3600 = 3_600;
```

#### ONE\_HOUR.vary

```ts
readonly vary: readonly ["Accept-Language"];
```

### ONE\_WEEK

```ts
readonly ONE_WEEK: object;
```

One-week cache with `Vary: Accept-Language`.

Suitable for stable, infrequently-changing data.

#### Example

```ts
return jsonOk(stableContent, { cache: CachePresets.ONE_WEEK });
// Cache-Control: max-age=604800
// Vary: Accept-Language
```

#### ONE\_WEEK.maxAge

```ts
readonly maxAge: 604800 = 604_800;
```

#### ONE\_WEEK.vary

```ts
readonly vary: readonly ["Accept-Language"];
```

### THIRTY\_SECONDS

```ts
readonly THIRTY_SECONDS: object;
```

30-second cache with `Vary: Accept-Language`.

Suitable for frequently-changing data where a brief staleness window is
acceptable, such as planner results.

#### Example

```ts
// Planner results — refresh every 30 seconds
return jsonOk(plannerResults, { cache: CachePresets.THIRTY_SECONDS });
// Cache-Control: max-age=30
// Vary: Accept-Language
```

#### THIRTY\_SECONDS.maxAge

```ts
readonly maxAge: 30 = 30;
```

#### THIRTY\_SECONDS.vary

```ts
readonly vary: readonly ["Accept-Language"];
```

## Example

```ts
import { jsonOk, CachePresets } from "@backpack/aws-lambda/rest";

return jsonOk(ticket, { cache: CachePresets.DURABLE });
return jsonOk(plannerResults, { cache: CachePresets.THIRTY_SECONDS });
```
